disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.en: Credential-related keywords appearing in test tools and benchmark data (e.g., curl in the FORBIDDEN_COMMANDS list) are part of the test framework's verification logic, not behavior of the plugin itself.

evidence.en: The dsh extension code (extensions/dsh/index.js, bootstrap.js) performs no credential file reads; it only reads its own skills directory and ~/.config/aegis/config.toml. checked_items.zh: 审查了 dsh 扩展注入模型的引导文案（extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js 通过 agent/session-start + agent.inject 注入的 using-aegis 技能内容）：该文案为方法包路由纪律，明确声明用户指令优先（「User/project instructions outrank Aegis」），无窃取、自改、越权等恶意指令。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the bootstrap text injected into the model by the dsh extension (extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js injects the using-aegis skill content via agent/session-start + agent.inject): this text is about method-pack routing discipline, explicitly stating that user instructions take priority ("User/project instructions outrank Aegis"), and contains no malicious instructions such as theft, self-modification, or privilege escalation.

checked_items.zh: 抽查了 4 个技能文件（using-aegis、update-aegis、anti-entropy-governance、dispatching-parallel-agents）以及 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.github/copilot-instructions.md 等模型可达文案，均为方法包工作流指导，无指令覆写、系统消息伪装、凭据读取诱导、安装诱导等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Spot-checked 4 skill files (using-aegis, update-aegis, anti-entropy-governance, dispatching-parallel-agents) as well as model-reachable texts such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .github/copilot-instructions.md; all are method-pack workflow guidance with no injection wording such as instruction overriding, system message spoofing, credential-read inducement, or installation inducement.

checked_items.zh: 审查了各宿主会话钩子（hooks/session-start、hooks/copilot-session-start.ps1）注入的文案：为 using-aegis 热路径与遗留技能目录迁移提醒，内容与方法包路由纪律一致，无恶意内容。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the texts injected by the host session hooks (hooks/session-start, hooks/copilot-session-start.ps1): they consist of the using-aegis hot path and legacy skills directory migration reminders, consistent with the method-pack routing discipline, containing no malicious content.

evidence.zh: dsh 扩展未注册任何工具，不产生工具描述文本；注入模型的引导文案（extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js 注入的 using-aegis 技能内容）为路由纪律且声明用户指令优先，无恶意指令。
evidence.en: The dsh extension registers no tools, so it produces no tool description text. The bootstrap text injected into the model (the using-aegis skill content injected by extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js) is routing discipline and declares user instruction priority, with no malicious instructions.

evidence.zh: 引导文案与技能文档均未出现诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；update-aegis 技能要求显式用户请求才执行更新操作，并在文档中明确说明「Do not perform background automatic updates」。
evidence.en: Neither the bootstrap text nor the skill documentation contains wording that induces installation, config rewriting, or permission loosening. The update-aegis skill requires an explicit user request before performing an update operation, and the documentation explicitly states "Do not perform background automatic updates".

evidence.zh: dsh 扩展使用 agent/session-start + agent.inject 合法注入自身引导文案，未监听 agent/pre-step 事件改写用户消息，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The dsh extension uses agent/session-start + agent.inject to legitimately inject its own bootstrap text; it does not listen to the agent/pre-step event to rewrite user messages, so this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 对预扫描提示的 33 个机械命中逐条人工核查并全部排除为良性：CI 工作流（DSH-X07 对应 DG-R3-59）为常规 checkout+测试；OpenCode 宿主插件（DSH-X03 对应 DG-R3-55）的 execFile 仅用于启动版本自检（git ls-remote 至固定仓库，3 秒超时，不阻塞启动）；技能目录图表渲染脚本（DSH-X03 对应 DG-R3-55）仅以固定命令调用本机 graphviz；两个 README 徽标中的高熵 base64 串（DSH-X08 对应 DG-R3-60）为 SVG 图片数据；24 个 SKILL.md 文件（DSH-X10 对应 DG-R2-57）为方法包工作流定义，内容审查良性；4 处网络命令命中（DSH-C05 对应 DG-R4-53）为第三方安装文档引用、测试用例中被禁止的命令清单和测试数据，非插件外联行为。
checked_items.en: Each of the 33 mechanical hits flagged by the pre-scan was manually reviewed and all were ruled out as benign: the CI workflow (DSH-X07 corresponding to DG-R3-59) is a routine checkout plus test; the OpenCode host plugin (DSH-X03 corresponding to DG-R3-55) uses execFile only to launch a version self-check (git ls-remote to a fixed repository, 3-second timeout, non-blocking); the skills directory graph rendering script (DSH-X03 corresponding to DG-R3-55) only invokes local graphviz with a fixed command; the high-entropy base64 strings in two README badges (DSH-X08 corresponding to DG-R3-60) are SVG image data; the 24 SKILL.md files (DSH-X10 corresponding to DG-R2-57) are method-pack workflow definitions with benign content review; the 4 network command hits (DSH-C05 corresponding to DG-R4-53) are references in third-party installation documentation, a list of forbidden commands in test cases, and test data, not plugin outbound behavior.
